flows.objective: On the page, find the primary call-to-action button labelled 'View portfolio' and click it. After the click, assert three things: (1) a portfolio section or panel is visible on the page; (2) the visible portfolio section contains at least one company name; (3) clicking the button produced a visible change on the page. The test PASSES when all three are true, and FAILS if any one of them is false.

Read the whole page and assert that no visible text reads 'undefined', 'null', 'NaN', 'Lorem ipsum', 'TODO' or 'coming soon', and that every table cell has a real value. The test PASSES when the page contains none of those placeholder strings and every table cell holds a real value. The test FAILS if any such placeholder text is present, and the failure message must quote the exact offending text.

View the page at a narrow mobile viewport of 375px wide. Assert that the page does not scroll sideways, and that the headline and the primary call-to-action button are fully visible and not overlapping. The test PASSES when there is no horizontal overflow and both the headline and the button are fully visible without overlap. The test FAILS if content overflows horizontally or is cut off.

Fill in the email field of the newsletter form with a plausible address (for example founder@example.com) and submit the form. The test PASSES when a visible confirmation message appears after submitting AND the email field still holds the submitted value, so no field was silently dropped. The test FAILS if nothing visibly happens after the click, or if the form clears without any confirmation. Quote exactly what was visible after submitting.

Read the headline at the top of the page and the text on the primary call-to-action button, then click that button. The test PASSES when the click reveals content that actually matches what the headline and the button label promised, such as a portfolio of real named companies and not a placeholder, AND the button label does not contradict the headline. The test FAILS if the revealed panel is empty, if it says it is 'coming soon', or if it contains placeholder text. Quote the headline, the button label and exactly what the revealed panel said.
